name: NTE web apps
install:
set -euo pipefail
if ! ls /usr/lib/postgresql/*/bin/initdb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y postgresql
fi
npm ci
npm ci --prefix nte-command-center
start:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Cloud Agent boot script. Idempotent: skips anything already listening.
# Vite flags must be passed with an extra "--" through each npm workspace script.
# tmux does not forward arbitrary environment variables, so they are set inside the session.
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace

INVITE_CODE="${INVITE_CODE:-local-dev}"
CORS_ORIGINS="${CORS_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:5173,http://127.0.0.1:5173,http://localhost:5174,http://127.0.0.1:5174,http://localhost:5175,http://127.0.0.1:5175,http://localhost:5176,http://127.0.0.1:5176,http://localhost:5177,http://127.0.0.1:5177,http://localhost:5178,http://127.0.0.1:5178,http://localhost:5179,http://127.0.0.1:5179}"
PORT="${PORT:-4000}"

port_open() {
  curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:${1}${2}"
}

ensure_session() {
  local name="$1" port="$2" path="$3" cmd="$4"
  if port_open "$port" "$path"; then
    echo "$name already listening on $port"
    return 0
  fi
  if tmux has-session -t "$name" 2>/dev/null; then
    tmux kill-session -t "$name"
  fi
  tmux new-session -d -s "$name" -c /workspace -- \
    bash -lc "export INVITE_CODE=$(printf %q "$INVITE_CODE") CORS_ORIGINS=$(printf %q "$CORS_ORIGINS") PORT=$(printf %q "$PORT"); exec $cmd"
  echo "started $name"
}

wait_for() {
  local name="$1" port="$2" path="$3"
  local i
  for i in $(seq 1 90); do
    if port_open "$port" "$path"; then
      echo "$name ready on $port"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  echo "$name did not become ready on $port" >&2
  tmux capture-pane -pt "$name" -S -80 >&2 || true
  return 1
}

ensure_session nte-server 4000 /api/health "npm run dev:server"
ensure_session deal-architect 5173 / "npm run dev --workspace=apps/deal-architect -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort"
ensure_session capital-readiness 5174 / "npm run dev --workspace=apps/capital-readiness -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort"
ensure_session notes-underwriting 5175 / "npm run dev --workspace=apps/notes-underwriting -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5175 --strictPort"
ensure_session legacy-estate 5176 / "npm run dev --workspace=apps/legacy-estate -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5176 --strictPort"
ensure_session financial-services-crm 5177 / "npm run dev --workspace=apps/financial-services-crm -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5177 --strictPort"
ensure_session member-portal 5178 / "npm run dev --workspace=apps/member-portal -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5178 --strictPort"

wait_for nte-server 4000 /api/health
wait_for deal-architect 5173 /
wait_for capital-readiness 5174 /
wait_for notes-underwriting 5175 /
wait_for legacy-estate 5176 /
wait_for financial-services-crm 5177 /
wait_for member-portal 5178 /

if npm run 2>/dev/null | grep -q dev:network-desk; then
  ensure_session network-desk 5179 / "npm run dev --workspace=apps/network-desk -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5179 --strictPort"
  wait_for network-desk 5179 /
fi
echo "all dev servers ready"
